description:
Job Title: Full Stack Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
* * * 
 
 
 Build Mission-Critical Solutions That Matter 
 Are you a passionate Full Stack Developer who thrives on solving complex challenges and delivering software that directly supports national security missions? We're looking for a developer who combines strong technical expertise with curiosity, initiative, and desire to solve meaningful problems. You bring deep experience across multiple technologies and enjoy working in an environment where ownership, adaptability, and innovation are highly valued.
 Join CACI and become a key contributor to one of our customer's flagship applications operating in a highly secure, mission-focused environment. In this role, you won't just write code. You'll help shape the future of the platform, influence technical direction, engage directly with stakeholders, and drive capabilities that support real-world mission outcomes.
 This is an opportunity to take ownership of a high-visibility product, collaborate with talented engineers, and make an immediate impact on systems that are relied upon every day. You'll work in a fast-paced Agile environment where your ideas are valued, your expertise is trusted, and your contributions directly influence both current operations and future capabilities.

 Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop, and enhance mission-critical web applications
 Partner with customers and stakeholders to transform mission needs into innovative technical solutions
 Modernize and maintain application architecture, services, and user interfaces
 Influence product direction and technology decisions
 Troubleshoot complex technical challenges and deliver resilient, scalable solutions
 Collaborate within an Agile team focused on continuous improvement and mission success
 You should possess advanced experience in several of the following areas:
 Angular and modern front-end development frameworks
 JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, C#, and CSS
 Node.js application development
 Oracle database design, development, and optimization
 RESTful and legacy web services development and integration
 Secure authentication technologies including SAML and OIDC
 Server certificates, security configuration, and troubleshooting
 Enterprise application support and modernization efforts
  
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 TS/SCI with Polygraph Clearance required
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
 7 or more years of experience developing and/or deploying software on high side environments
 Must be proficient or above in: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Angular Material UI components
 Node.js and TypeScript
 
 Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
 Direct experience using secure authentication technologies like SAML and OIDC
 Ability to learn and apply functional concepts very quickly
   
 Desired: 
 Able to plan strategically and execute your work within an Agile development construct and work independently
 Ability to work independently and demonstrate good critical thinking
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$90,300-$189,600 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
